historical_record.description: The 36,000-square-foot corner lot, 240 feet on Quint Street and 150 feet on Custer Avenue, was vacant, inside the area marked for the Southeast Sewage Treatment Plant's expansion.
The City Planning Commission unanimously refused an automobile wrecking yard on the vacant lot, which the City expected to buy for the Southeast Sewage Treatment Plant's expansion.

With the Bayview-Hunters Point Community Coordinating Council's assent, the City Planning Commission unanimously authorized an automobile wrecking yard on the fenced 36,000-square-foot lot, already used to store cars awaiting dismantling, as part of the dismantling business at 389 Quint Street (Resolution 7461).
